description: This file defines an interface for client-side monitoring events within the AWS SDK. It specifies methods for retrieving, prepending, and appending monitoring events, but contains no implementation.

classes.name: Aws\MonitoringEventsInterface
classes.description: An interface to add and retrieve client-side monitoring events

methods.name: getMonitoringEvents
methods.description: Retrieve client-side monitoring events associated with an object

methods.name: prependMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Prepend a monitoring event to the object's event list

methods.name: appendMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Append a monitoring event to the object's event list
